business_problem: The company previously relied on a hybrid approach, combining paper-based scheduling and charting systems, on-premises legacy tools, and another cloud provider for its digital workloads. CBI Health migrated to AWS to reduce costs and secure and modernize its infrastructure to help improve customer outcomes and experiences and drive efficiencies in its operating model.
solution_summary: CBI Health , a Canadian rehabilitation provider, wanted to migrate its legacy and paper-based systems to the cloud to enhance its service delivery. To begin its digital transformation journey, CBI Health needed to migrate its physical data centers, containing 70 TB of data, to the cloud before its upcoming contract renewal. The company harnessed AWS Experience-Based Acceleration (AWS EBA), which is used to build cloud foundations, migrate at scale, modernize businesses, and innovate with an outcome-focused transformation methodology. The company also plans to improve its contact center using Amazon Connect , an artificial intelligence–powered contact center from AWS. “Using AWS has helped us to literally remove the legacy technical debt completely, and in the future it will empower us with straightforward access to the data,” says Segal. “We’ll have new workloads in analytics, artificial intelligence, or other innovative components using AWS.”

solution_components.name: Amazon Connect
solution_components.role: Provides the delivery or user-facing interface for the security analytics workload.

business_outcome: CBI Health will drive more business efficiencies and find opportunities to better service its customers and employees using AWS while continuing to optimize costs in the long term. metrics: To begin its digital transformation journey, CBI Health needed to migrate its physical data centers, containing 70 TB of data, to the cloud before its upcoming contract renewal.
With a tight deadline, CBI Health worked alongside AWS customer solutions managers and migrated 100 percent of its legacy infrastructure to the cloud in 3 months.
evidence_quotes: The company previously relied on a hybrid approach, combining paper-based scheduling and charting systems, on-premises legacy tools, and another cloud provider for its digital workloads.
CBI Health migrated to AWS to reduce costs and secure and modernize its infrastructure to help improve customer outcomes and experiences and drive efficiencies in its operating model.
CBI Health achieved full migration in two sprints, working alongside AWS customer solutions managers and Adastra , an AWS Partner that specializes in data and analytics solutions.
CBI Health applied AWS EBA to migrate 40 percent of its infrastructure in the first 3-day sprint.
The company completed its migration during the second sprint, and by December 2023, CBI Health had no physical infrastructure remaining.

It was also critical that the company didn’t experience any unplanned downtime during migration because this could adversely affect healthcare practitioners and the customers receiving care from them.
